clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Mitsuwa seeks sacred charms stolen from his kin. A traveling party of Darkspear trolls was ambushed and slaughtered by the Thistlefur furbolgs, who took the talismans into their den.

Zoram'gar Outpost is a remote Horde refuge on Ashenvale's western coast. Woodland paths make travel there dangerous. A party of Darkspear trolls never reached the post after the Thistlefur furbolgs ambushed them. Mitsuwa accepts that his kin have died and will one day meet him in the afterlife. Their sacred charms were stolen from the dead, however, and he cannot abide that insult.

Troll charms and talismans mark identity, offer spiritual protection, and bind their bearers to the Loa. Mitsuwa sees a troll without her charm as hollow and worthless, like an orc without battle scars. The Thistlefur furbolgs carried the stolen charms to Thistlefur Hold, deep in the caves beyond Thistlefur Village. They hid the talismans in chests, far from their rightful owners.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My kinfolk were traveling here with many sacred troll charms, but the Thistlefur furbolgs attacked and killed them before they reached Zoram'gar! Those vile Furbolgs!
I miss my brothers and sisters who were killed, but we will meet again in the afterlife. However, their troll charms hold great value in this world. It is an outrage that the furbolgs have them!
Friend, you must retrieve the charms! They are in chests in Thistlefur Hold, a cave at the end of Thistlefur Village, north of Astranaar.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find the charms, friend? Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You found them! Thank you! Thank you, friend! You do not know how great a thing you have done for me.
A troll without their charm is like an orc without their battle scars...
